caseName: Dastar Corp. v. Twentieth Century Fox Film Corp.
caseNameFull: Dastar Corp. v. Twentieth Century Fox Film Corp. Et Al.

opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir. Certiorari granted. Brief of petitioner is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Friday, February 14, 2003. Brief of respondents is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, March 10, 2003. A reply brief, if any, is to be filed with the Clerk and served upon opposing counsel on or before 3 p.m., Monday, March 24, 2003. This Court's Rule 29.2 does not apply.

Justice Breyer took no part in the consideration or decision of this petition.
